object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Type as From, with To = latest commit, each of these names for the same older commit: a 7-digit prefix of its hash, its full hash, a unique 4-digit prefix, a tag on it, a local branch on it, a remote-tracking branch on it, and expressions that count back from the latest commit, such as HEAD~2 and @~2. Expected: each compares that commit with the latest commit and lists the same rows as choosing the commit from the list. Boundary: a 3-digit prefix of the same hash isn't accepted, and the error of MELLON-VER-SRS-10 names it.
